Container.Name: Unraid-Control
Container.Overview: [b]Unraid Control[/b] is a secure, self-hosted PWA for monitoring and controlling one or more Unraid servers. It provides dashboards for system metrics, array storage, Docker containers, virtual machines, shares, files, notifications, and logs.[br][br][b]First run:[/b] Set a unique local password below. Open the WebUI, then add your Unraid server URL and API key. SSH/SFTP can be configured later in the application for logs and file access.
Container.Description: Responsive self-hosted PWA for monitoring and controlling Unraid servers through GraphQL and optional SSH/SFTP.
Container.Requires: An Unraid server with an accessible GraphQL API and API key. SSH is optional.

Config.Name: Web UI Port
Config.Description: Host port used to access the Unraid Control web interface.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Persistent encrypted server configuration, encryption key, and audit log.

Config.Name: Local UI Password
Config.Description: Unique password used to unlock the application. Minimum 12 characters. Changing it invalidates existing sessions.

Config.Name: Time Zone
Config.Description: Container time zone, for example Europe/Paris or America/New_York.

Config.Name: Encryption Key
Config.Description: Optional 32-byte key encoded as base64 or 64 hexadecimal characters. Leave empty to generate and persist a private key in Appdata.

Config.Name: Maximum Upload Size
Config.Description: Maximum SFTP upload size in bytes. The default is 2 GiB.

Config.Name: Trust Reverse Proxy
Config.Description: Set to true only when the application runs behind a trusted reverse proxy.

Config.Name: GraphQL Schema URL
Config.Description: Optional official Unraid GraphQL schema URL override. Leave empty for automatic selection.
